translations.web: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.
translations.bsb: Their land is full of silver and gold, with no limit to their treasures; their land is full of horses, with no limit to their chariots.
translations.kjv: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
